description: Work out the maximum home price a Canadian buyer qualifies for: binary-searches the price that keeps both the GDS (39%) and TDS (44%) ratios satisfied at the OSFI stress-test rate, honouring the Dec-2024 minimum down payment tiers and the $1.5M CMHC insurability ceiling. Returns max price, max mortgage, CMHC premium, monthly payment, and the GDS/TDS ratios.
